standard-dialogue.npc: Do you know any other tortoise trainers?

options.text: So what are you training these tortoises to do?

steps.npc: Tortoises are naturally pacifistic animals that eat nothing but cabbages. I am required to beat those peaceful tendencies out of the softies and turn them into hardened battle-trained killers.
Firstly I acclimatise them to excessive aural stimulation and simple physical confrontation.

steps.player: You shout at them and beat them with sticks?

steps.npc: Of course. Then I re-educate them to become comfortable with riders and military combat situations.

steps.player: You sit on their backs and prod them with sharp pointy things.
Doesn't seem very fair on the tortoises.

steps.npc: This is War! Fairness is a luxury of the weak.

options.text: Where did these tortoises come from?

steps.npc: Isn't it obvious? Surely even to your untrained eye that giant tortoises are the perfect mobile armoured field unit?
They are sturdy animals, and well protected by their shell. They can even swim! All we need to do is put a bit of fire in their bellies.

options.text: So what are you training these tortoises to do?
Where did these tortoises come from?
Where did these tortoises come from?

steps.player: Where do these tortoises come from?

steps.npc: We breed them. The originals were found by gnome explorers back in King Healthorg the Great's rule. On their discovery King Healthorg authorised a small party to go there and transport a breeding pair back here. He
kept one for himself to ride into battle.
Trouble is they take a lot of skill and time to breed, so we're only just getting them battle ready.

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player doesn't have the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player has a premade item in their inventory:

steps.text: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player has the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Trainer Nacklepen
If the player does have a reward token available:
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
If the player has an unclaimed reward token:
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
If the player has claimed their reward token:

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player ran out of time:

steps.text: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
